app.name: HouseMD
start.tagline: Write markdown in the browser, straight into your files. No server: the folder stays on your computer.
unsupported.ios: HouseMD does not work on iOS: every browser there uses Safari's engine, which cannot edit local folders.
unsupported.firefox: HouseMD does not work on Firefox, which cannot edit local folders. Use Chrome or Edge.
unsupported.safari: HouseMD does not work on Safari, which cannot edit local folders. Use Chrome or Edge.
unsupported.other: HouseMD needs a browser that can edit local folders: use Chrome or Edge on desktop.
orphans.title: Drafts without a file
empty.hint: Pick a file from the sidebar or create a new one.
dialog.rename.title: Rename {name}
dialog.delete.title: Delete {name}?
dialog.delete.folder: The folder and everything in it will be deleted from disk.
dialog.delete.file: The file will be deleted from disk.
name.error.dot: The name cannot start with a dot
name.error.taken: An item with this name already exists
access.title: Folder access lost
access.body: The browser no longer allows editing “{folder}”. Unsaved changes are safe in this browser.
conflict.message: The file changed on disk while you had unsaved changes.
tree.label: Folder files
search.label: Search in files
settings.title: Settings
history.title: History of {path}
history.empty: No saved versions of this file yet.
history.pick: Pick a version to see what changed.
toast.restoredDraftDeleted: Restored the unsaved changes of {path} (the file no longer exists on disk)
toast.saveAllSkipped: {count} changes not saved: their file changed or was deleted on disk, or could not be written. Open them to resolve.
toast.draftNotPersisted: Could not secure your changes: save the file or copy the text
toast.bufferFailed: Could not write the emergency copy: {detail}
toast.restoreCancelled: Restore cancelled: the document changed in the meantime
toast.newVersion: A new version of HouseMD is available
toast.reloadOtherTabs: HouseMD is open in another tab with an older version: save and close that tab to continue
ai.title: AI
ai.request: Ask about this document… (Shift+Enter for a new line)
ai.emptyProposal: Write a request or pick a suggestion.
ai.streamingPreview: New response (your edited proposal is preserved)
ai.changedWarning: The document changed after this proposal. Accepting all replaces your newer edits.
ai.name: Name
ai.secretNotice: A saved key is readable by browser extensions and anyone using this browser profile. Use a dedicated key with a spending limit.
ai.syncNotice: Best effort sync of presets and profiles, never API keys. Replicated folders may conflict; local databases must remain intact for recovery.
ai.syncRestoreWarning: This replaces all presets and profiles on all connected browsers. A backup is saved first. Copying a backup manually is not a restore.
ai.help.ollama: Start Ollama with OLLAMA_ORIGINS set to the HouseMD origin. Allow local network access in Chrome.
ai.help.lmstudio: Enable CORS in LM Studio and start the local server.
ai.help.claude-code: Start npm run bridge with ALLOWED_ORIGINS including this HouseMD origin.
ai.help.anthropic: Uses the Anthropic API directly with your dedicated API key.
ai.help.openai-compatible: The endpoint must allow browser CORS requests. Configure a proxy URL if needed.
ai.warning.urls: Link or image URLs changed or removed.
ai.warning.length: Unexpected amount of text changed; review carefully.
ai.warning.truncated: Output limit reached; the end may be missing.
ai.error.unreachable: Cannot reach the server. Check CORS, server availability and Chrome local-network permission.
ai.error.bridgeDown: Bridge unavailable. Start npm run bridge.
ai.error.bridgeIncompatible: This is not a compatible, protected HouseMD bridge. No document was sent.
ai.error.secretBinding: The key belongs to a different provider or endpoint. Enter it again to confirm this endpoint.
ai.error.scopeLost: The selection changed. Select it again and retry.
ai.error.bridgeCli: Claude CLI failed. Check installation and subscription login.
ai.error.originRejected: This HouseMD origin is not allowed by the bridge.
ai.error.paramRejected: A parameter was rejected. Remove it in Parameters and retry.
ai.error.tooLong: The request exceeds the context window. Use a smaller selection or smaller parts.
ai.error.server: The operation failed. Retry or check configuration.
ai.error.badStream: The server returned an invalid stream.
ai.error.syncBackupFailed: Backup failed; the sync file was not changed.
ai.error.syncLocked: Sync file is busy. Retry later.
ai.error.aiPendingUpdate: Accept or discard AI proposals, or stop the request, before updating.
ai.unsavedMessage: The changes to this item have not been saved.
